name: Ananias
bio: Ananias, a disciple in Damascus, was told in a vision by the Lord to go to Saul, who had been struck blind on the road to Damascus; though he protested that Saul had persecuted the believers, the Lord told him Saul was a chosen instrument to carry his name to the Gentiles. Ananias went, laid hands on Saul, and told him Jesus had sent him to restore his sight and fill him with the Holy Spirit; Saul's sight was immediately restored, and he was baptized (Acts 9:10-18). He is a different figure from Ananias the husband of Sapphira and the high priest Ananias who later presided over Paul's trial.
